content-clip-repurpose.title: Turn streams into short-form clips
content-clip-repurpose.description: You've put in roughly {streamedHours} hours of streaming recently but only have {clipsCreated} clips. Repurpose highlights to reach audiences who don't catch live streams.
content-clip-repurpose.whyItMatters: Short-form clips drive discovery on TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels — often outperforming full VOD uploads for new viewer acquisition.

sponsors-engagement-ready.title: You're ready to pitch sponsors
sponsors-engagement-ready.description: Your content engagement rate is {engagementRate}% with no active sponsorship deals. Brands look for creators with proven audience interaction before signing.
sponsors-engagement-ready.whyItMatters: Strong engagement signals an invested audience — the top metric sponsors evaluate alongside reach and brand fit.

goals-missed-posting-cadence.title: Catch up on missed uploads
goals-missed-posting-cadence.description: You missed your usual upload days this week ({missedLabel}).
goals-missed-posting-cadence.descriptionWithRhythm: You missed {missedCount, plural, one {# expected upload} other {# expected uploads}} this week ({missedLabel}). Your connected platforms show you usually publish on {rhythmOnlyLabel}.
goals-missed-posting-cadence.whyItMatters: Consistent publishing on your strongest days compounds algorithmic reach and trains your audience when to show up.

goals-upload-consistency.title: Build a consistent upload rhythm
goals-upload-consistency.description: You've published {uploadsCompleted} recent pieces against a goal of {uploadGoal} this period. Consistency compounds algorithmic favor and audience habit.
goals-upload-consistency.whyItMatters: Platforms reward regular publishing schedules. Creators who post consistently see 2–3× better retention over 90 days.

goals-momentum-double-down.title: Double down on what's working
goals-momentum-double-down.description: Your audience is growing at {followersGrowth}% — well above average. Capitalize on this momentum before it plateaus.
goals-momentum-double-down.whyItMatters: Growth spurts are windows to convert casual viewers into loyal followers and monetize through memberships or merch.

title.creator: Block streaming time on your calendar

description.creator: You don't have recurring schedule blocks set up. A visible streaming schedule helps your audience show up and improves platform recommendations.
description.organization: No events are scheduled for today. Blocking time keeps your roster accountable and surfaces conflicts early.

productivity-stream-schedule.whyItMatters: Creators with predictable schedules retain 40% more returning viewers than those who stream sporadically.

business-revenue-tracking.title: Start tracking your revenue

description.creator: Connect a platform account or log revenue entries so you can see earnings trends and make informed business decisions.
description.organization: No platform revenue is connected across your roster. Link creator accounts to unlock earnings visibility and forecasting.

business-revenue-tracking.whyItMatters: You can't optimize what you don't measure. Revenue tracking reveals which platforms and deal types drive the most income.

sponsors-overdue-deliverables.title: Clear overdue deliverables
sponsors-overdue-deliverables.description: You have {overdueDeliverables, plural, one {# overdue deliverable} other {# overdue deliverables}}. Late deliverables risk contract renewals and future sponsor trust.
sponsors-overdue-deliverables.whyItMatters: Sponsors track fulfillment closely. On-time delivery is the strongest predictor of repeat deals.

branding-connect-platform.title: Connect your primary platform
branding-connect-platform.description: Link your {primaryPlatform} account to unlock performance insights and personalized coaching based on real content data.
branding-connect-platform.whyItMatters: Connected accounts power analytics, revenue tracking, and AI recommendations tailored to your actual audience.

networking-apply-opportunities.title: Apply to open opportunities
networking-apply-opportunities.description: {openOpportunities, plural, one {# sponsorship opportunity is} other {# sponsorship opportunities are}} open and you haven't submitted an application yet.
networking-apply-opportunities.whyItMatters: Early applicants often get prioritized review. Even a tailored pitch to one opportunity can open your next deal.

community-unread-messages.title: Respond to pending messages
community-unread-messages.description: You have {unreadMessages, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}. Quick responses keep sponsor and team conversations moving.
community-unread-messages.whyItMatters: Response time affects deal velocity. Sponsors and managers prioritize creators who communicate reliably.

personal-development-profile.title: Complete your creator profile
personal-development-profile.description: Your profile is {profileReadinessScore}% ready. Next step: {nextStep}.
personal-development-profile.whyItMatters: Complete profiles rank higher in sponsor searches and give managers the context they need to pitch you effectively.

business-grow-roster.title: Expand your creator roster
business-grow-roster.description: You have {activeCreatorsCount, plural, one {# active creator} other {# active creators}}. Growing your roster diversifies revenue and sponsorship opportunities.
business-grow-roster.whyItMatters: Agencies with diverse rosters close more multi-creator deals and weather platform algorithm changes better.

revenue-expiring-contracts.title: Review expiring contracts
revenue-expiring-contracts.description: {expiringContractsCount, plural, one {# contract expires} other {# contracts expire}} within 45 days. Start renewal conversations now.
revenue-expiring-contracts.whyItMatters: Proactive renewals prevent revenue gaps and give sponsors time to adjust budgets.

productivity-review-applications.title: Review pending applications
productivity-review-applications.description: {pendingApplications, plural, one {# creator application needs} other {# creator applications need}} your review.
productivity-review-applications.whyItMatters: Fast application turnaround keeps top talent engaged and improves your agency's reputation with creators.

goals-personalized-consistency.title: Stick to your posting plan
goals-personalized-consistency.description: You set consistency as your top goal. Block time on {days} and publish at least {uploadGoal} pieces this period.
goals-personalized-consistency.whyItMatters: Creators who publish on a predictable rhythm see stronger retention and algorithmic reach over 90 days.

goals-personalized-monetization.title: Map your monetization paths
goals-personalized-monetization.description: Connect platforms or log revenue entries to see which income streams are gaining traction.
goals-personalized-monetization.whyItMatters: Clear revenue data helps you double down on the channels that actually pay off.

goals-personalized-sponsorship.title: Build your sponsor-ready package
goals-personalized-sponsorship.description: Sponsors look for complete profiles and proven engagement. Update your creator profile and browse open deals.
goals-personalized-sponsorship.whyItMatters: A sponsor-ready profile plus active applications is the fastest path to your first brand deal.

goals-personalized-growth-clips.title: Scale your short-form output
goals-personalized-growth-clips.description: You said short-form clips are a focus. Repurpose stream or long-form highlights into clips to reach new audiences.
goals-personalized-growth-clips.whyItMatters: Short-form discovery often outpaces live-only growth on TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Reels.

goals-personalized-brand.title: Sharpen your creator positioning
goals-personalized-brand.description: Building your brand starts with a complete profile — bio, platforms, and portfolio pieces sponsors can evaluate quickly.
goals-personalized-brand.whyItMatters: Strong positioning makes you memorable to sponsors and helps your content feel cohesive across platforms.

analytics-connect-platforms.title: Connect creator platform accounts
analytics-connect-platforms.description: No platform accounts are linked yet. Connecting accounts unlocks revenue tracking and performance analytics across your roster.
analytics-connect-platforms.whyItMatters: Platform data powers accurate reporting for sponsors and helps you identify which creators are ready for bigger deals.
